title: te rangi o ngā maunga i te ahiahi
intro: Whakarongo mai ki ngā awaawa e haruru ana me te whakamoemiti i te taha o tētahi pononga whiriwhiri a Allah. He reo waiata, he whakatau e rapuhia ana e ngā kaiwhakahē i te rūma, me te konganuku kua whakangawaritia e te whakahau a te Atua e tatari ana kia kitea. Ko tēhea te ahua o te karakia me te ture tika e kōrero ana mā roto i ēnei tohu?
clues: I manaakitia ahau e Allah ki te taonga nui, me te reo waiata whakamoemiti.
I whakaakona ahau e Allah ki te mārama ki te reo o te whakawa tika i waenganui i te hunga tautohe.
I tūtaki ahau ki tētahi toa nui whakaharahara i te pakanga, ā, nā te pai o Allah i toa ai ahau i a rātou.
I homai ki ahau te whakaaro nui, te mana, me te karaipiture o ngā himene i whakakitea mai e Allah.
I te ahiahi, i te whitinga hoki o te rā, i hono mai ngā maunga me ngā manu ki ahau ki te whakakororia i a Allah.
I whakaakona ahau e Allah ki te hanga i ngā kōti rino hei whakangawari māku.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Poropiti a Rawiri (David)
Poropiti a Ihimaera (Ihimaera)
Poropiti a Yahya (Hoani)
Dhul-Kifli
Poropiti Al-Yasa (Eriha)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I hinga a Jalut (Koriata) i te pakanga i runga i te hiahia o Allah
I hanga te Āraka hei oranga mō te waipuke nui
I maka ki roto i te ahi i whakamataohia e te Atua
I horomia e te ika nui o te moana
I whakaarahia ki te rangi, kāore i pangia e te mate
trial.answer: I hinga a Jalut (Koriata) i te pakanga i runga i te hiahia o Allah

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ngā maunga me ngā manu e hono tahi ana ki te whakamoemiti ki a Allah
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He ahi i whakamatao, i rangimārie hoki
He kamera uha i tukuna hei tohu ki te iwi
He āaka rakau e takoto ana i runga i Maunga Hūti
location.answer: Ngā maunga me ngā manu e hono tahi ana ki te whakamoemiti ki a Allah

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakawhiwhia te rangatiratanga, te whakaaro nui, me te Zabur (Ngā Waiata)
I homai he tama i te koroheketanga i muri i te inoi nui
I whakawhiwhia te haumaru i roto i te ana mō ngā tau maha
I tukuna he puna o Zamzam i te koraha
Te toremitanga o te ope taua ki te moana
outcome.answer: I whakawhiwhia te rangatiratanga, te whakaaro nui, me te Zabur (Ngā Waiata)

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
